protocol.acceptance: One-sided exact binomial excess-error diagnostics at .05, Holm across every positive-panel family noncoverage and practical-null false-confirmation diagnostic. No diagnostic may reject. In the power panel, the one-sided 95% lower bound for gate-zero confirmation probability must be >=.80; all trials/refusals remain in the denominator. Numerical/native references must agree.
protocol.allocation: Original full family m; each of two marginal intervals gets .05/(2*m). No family shrinking or claim of simultaneous control across separate studies.
protocol.gates: 32 fixed intervals [j/64, j/64+prevalence) on independent Uniform(0,1) entity context.
protocol.negative_controls: 200 independent seeds each for an unmodelled global shock and naive duplicated-row inference, deliberately bypassing required assumptions/structural admission. Retain failures; do not treat them as product-admitted designs.
protocol.observation: Separate predeclared label-observation indicators independent of context/outcomes. Observed-label estimands; no selection correction is inferred.

partial_null_power.truth: current risk .40 in x<.125 and .10 elsewhere; reference risk .10

protocol.scope: Mathematics supplies finite guarantees under the declared IID complete-entity design, not simulation non-rejection. This does not qualify general complete-entity bootstrap, unbounded means, temporal dependence, discovery recovery or external provenance.
protocol.within_entity: One potential current and reference observation per entity. Binary errors use U<risk and U>.9; bounded values use U and 1-U. Dependence inside entities is intentional.
